title: Careers
description: Join XionTechs in Ho Chi Minh City: a forward-thinking team where innovation and collaboration thrive.
lede: At XionTechs, you are part of a forward-thinking team where innovation and collaboration thrive: an inspiring, inclusive place built for growth, ownership, and impactful work.

roles.note: Be patient: a new recruitment campaign starts soon.

innovative.name: Innovative environment
innovative.text: Be inspired by the visionary spirit of Xion as you work with cutting-edge technologies to create transformative IT systems.

culture.name: Empowering culture
culture.text: Be part of a “Beyond Employees Culture” that values startup spirit, innovation, and a “Get IT Done” mindset, where everyone belongs.

growth.name: Continuous growth
growth.text: Structured training, knowledge resources, and role-specific onboarding help you succeed from day one.

tech.name: Tech that excites
tech.text: Tackle challenging projects with AI/ML, generative AI, cloud computing, and Agile methods in a mature engineering environment.

impact.name: Real impact
impact.text: Build secure, high-quality solutions that drive digital transformation for businesses and innovators worldwide.
